board.empty: Every material is in good supply. Switch to All materials to see them.
board.noResult: No material matches. Clear the search or the filters.
board.noSupplierHint: No supplier sells this material. Add one in Master data.

orders.search: Search by number, supplier or material
orders.empty: No purchase orders yet. Create one from the stock status board.
orders.noResult: No purchase order matches. Clear the search or the filters.
orders.noContact: No contact recorded for this supplier.

receipts.search: Search by number, purchase order, supplier or material
receipts.empty: No goods receipts yet. Receive goods from a sent purchase order.
receipts.noResult: No receipt matches. Clear the search or the filters.
receipts.noOpenPo: No sent purchase order is waiting for goods.
receipts.choosePoFirst: Choose a purchase order to see what is still open.
receipts.nothingOpen: Nothing is open on this purchase order.

fields.expectedHint: Filled from the longest lead time of the lines; change it if the supplier agreed another date.

lines.title: Materials
lines.chooseSupplierFirst: Choose a supplier first: only the materials it sells can be ordered.

validation.notSupplied: This supplier does not sell this material.
validation.priceWhole: Enter a whole number of yen.
validation.receiptLinesRequired: Choose a purchase order that has quantity open.
validation.acceptedTooMany: Accepted cannot be more than delivered.
validation.reasonRequired: Choose why a part was rejected.
validation.nothingDelivered: Enter what was delivered on at least one line.

send.title: Send this purchase order to the supplier?
send.description: The order is approved. It is sent to the supplier and cannot be edited after it is sent; the quantity is counted as on order.

back-to-draft.title: Take the purchase order back to draft?
back-to-draft.description: Only possible while nothing was received. You can edit it and send it again.
back-to-draft.done: Purchase order is a draft again

cancel.title: Cancel this purchase order?
cancel.description: It stays in the list as cancelled and cannot receive goods. Draft receipts are cancelled with it.

close-remaining.title: Close the purchase order with what is still open?
close-remaining.description: The supplier will not deliver the open quantity. Say why; the reason is kept in the history.

close.title: Close this purchase order?
close.description: Everything was received. The purchase order is finished.

revert.title: Go back to the previous status?
revert.description: Use this to correct a wrong click. The reason is kept in the history.

postReceipt.title: Post this goods receipt?
postReceipt.description: The accepted quantity goes into the stock now. A receipt can be posted only once.
postReceipt.done: Receipt posted, the stock is updated

cancelReceipt.title: Cancel this goods receipt?
cancelReceipt.description: A posted receipt takes its quantity out of the stock again and gives it back to the purchase order.

request-approval.title: Ask a Manager to approve this purchase order?
request-approval.description: The order is locked while it waits. A Purchase Manager checks it and approves or rejects it by hand. Nothing is approved automatically.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the approval request?
withdraw.description: The order goes back to draft so you can edit it. Ask again when it is ready.

approve.title: Approve this purchase order?
approve.description: You confirm the supplier, the lines and the prices. The order can then be sent to the supplier. Your name and the time are kept in the approval log.

reject.title: Reject this purchase order?
reject.description: It goes back to the person who made it, who can correct it and ask again. Say what needs to change.

errors.INVALID_STATUS: This is not possible in the current status.
errors.POST_INVALID: The receipt cannot be posted as it is: the purchase order changed. Check the quantities.
errors.CANNOT_APPROVE_OWN: You made this purchase order. Another Purchase Manager must approve it.

approval.title: Approval
approval.reference: The totals are for reference only. A purchase order is approved only when a Manager presses Approve.
approval.waiting: Waiting for approval by a Purchase Manager.
approval.waitingOwn: You made this order, so another Purchase Manager must approve it.
approval.none: No approval has been asked for yet.

approvals.title: Approval log
approvals.intro: Every request, approval and rejection of a purchase order, with who did it and when. Entries are never changed or deleted.
approvals.search: Search by PO number, supplier, person or reason
approvals.noResult: No entry matches. Clear the search or the filters.
approvals.forbidden: Only a Purchase Manager or an Admin can read the approval log.

waitingGoods.title: Waiting for goods
waitingGoods.hint: Purchase orders that were sent and have not been fully received. This is what the number of Goods receipt in the menu counts, besides the draft receipts to post.
